launchColor.name: Indischrot (Guards Red)
launchColor.note: Best guess only. Carrera 2 joined about a year after the Carrera 4 (MY1990); no source found naming the colour of its launch/press car. The source URL confirms timing and price only.

porsche-911-964-carrera-2.note: Porsche Newsroom: Carrera 2 launched a year after the C4 from 103,500 DM. en.wikipedia: C2 Coupé 18,219 (plus Cabrio 11,013, Targa 3,534, Turbo-look Cabrio 1,532, Speedster 936). Our 19,484 not found in any source. de.wikipedia 1992 price: 122,340 DM.

launchColor.name: Indischrot (Guards Red)
launchColor.note: Secondary source: the Paris Salon 1988 premiere car was red (same red as the 1950 Paris 356), and all ~230 'Venturetour' dealer-launch Carrera 4s (March 1989) were red. Paint name inferred as Indischrot/Guards Red (the standard red of the period); no Porsche source naming the paint found.

porsche-911-964-carrera-4.note: Price: Porsche Newsroom, launch August 1988. Production 13,353 = Carrera 4 Coupé only (en.wikipedia table; plus 4,802 Cabrio, 1,329 Targa, 911 Jubilee coupé). de.wikipedia 1992 price: 135,550 DM.

launchColor.name: Rubinsternrot (Rubystone Red)
launchColor.note: Porsche Newsroom heritage pieces repeatedly feature a Rubystone (Star Ruby/Rubystar) 964 Carrera RS (also https://newsroom.porsche.com/en/2019/history/porsche-klassik-911-eight-generations-dna-18914.html), and Rubystone was new for MY1992 (RS launch year). The colour of the Geneva March 1991 show car itself was not found.

launchColor.name: Amethyst Metallic (Amethyst Metallic)
launchColor.note: Only source is a classified listing claiming this Amethyst metallic car (magenta leather, option 'Geneva Motor Show vehicle') was the first 964 Turbo shown at Geneva March 1990; not confirmed by Porsche. Listing describes it as a 'Turbo S' prototype with 381 PS, so treat with caution.

porsche-911-993-carrera.note: Price: MY1994 Carrera Coupé 125,760 DM (Porsche Newsroom). Launch power 200 kW/272 PS; 285 PS (Varioram) only from MY1996. porsche-911-993-carrera-4s.note: Unveiled IAA Frankfurt Sept 1995 (MY1996), Varioram 285 PS, 6,948 built. Launch DM price not verified.

launchColor.name: Speedgelb (Speed Yellow)
launchColor.note: A dealer description states Speed Yellow was the colour the model was presented in in the original sales brochure; not confirmed by Porsche. Shown Geneva March 1995. Standard colours were Black, Riviera Blue, Indian Red, Grand Prix White, Speed Yellow.
